validity.researcher_notes: P5509 ('Sabine Pass LNG Stage 5 Expansion Pipeline', LastUpdated 2023-07-20, near-empty: only Status/Fuel/Proposal/Location cells populated pre-sweep) and P7798 ('Sabine Crossing Gas Pipeline', LastUpdated 2025-09-22, fully populated) describe the SAME physical FERC-certificated pipeline. Independent verification: the project was pre-filed by Cheniere/Sabine Pass Liquefaction under FERC Docket PF23-2-000 in early 2023 as an unnamed 'Sabine Pass Stage 5' feed-gas line (NGI, 2023-08-17, name_found='Sabine Crossing'), formally named 'Sabine Crossing, LLC' when it filed an NGA application 2024-02-29 under Docket CP24-75-000 (Federal Register 2024-06773, withdrawn 2024-03-13 to optimize the route, pre-filing resumed under PF23-2-000), refiled under Docket CP25-505-000 with a binding open season 2025-04-21/05-02 (Cheniere's own Open Season notice, SCL-Open-Season.pdf: 55.6 mi, 48-inch, 2,764,800 Dth/d, in-service Q4 2031), formal application noticed 2025-06-24 (Federal Register 2025-11578: 55.6 mi / 48-inch / 2.7 Bcf/d / $1,626,222,797 estimated cost), NOI-EIS noticed 2025-08-13 (Federal Register 2025-15362), and a Draft EIS noticed 2026-04-08 under Docket CP24-75-001/CP25-505-000/CP25-506-000 as 'Sabine Crossing Pipeline, LLC' (Federal Register 2026-06766). EIA's own project tracker (releases Oct2023-Aug2026, sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects', project_key 'sabine crossing pipeline|sabine crossing llc') carries this SAME docket history end-to-end under project name 'Sabine Crossing Pipeline'. P7798's GEM row (checked against the fresh GGIT gas CSV, row index 4174) already carries essentially identical values -- LengthKnown 55.60 mi, Diameter 48 in, Capacity 2700.00 MMcf/d, StartYear1 2031, ProposalYear 2024, Owner Cheniere Energy 100% -- confirming it is this same 'Sabine Crossing' project, not a coincidence. (One discrepancy worth a note for whichever row survives: P7798 records StartState/Province=Texas, EndState/Province=Louisiana, EndLocation='Sabine Pass LNG Terminal', which is the REVERSE direction from the FERC application's own language -- 'extending FROM the Sabine Pass LNG Terminal ... into Liberty County, Texas' [2025-11578] -- i.e. the terminal in Cameron Parish, LA is the start, Liberty County, TX is the end.) P5509 predates the project's formal naming (created from the vague Feb/Mar-2023 pre-filing news before 'Sabine Crossing' existed as a docketed name) and was never updated as the docket progressed, while P7798 was created/maintained against the named, FERC-docketed entity. Recommend P7798 survive and P5509 be retired or redirected (OtherEnglishNames on the surviving row), pending the orchestrator's adjudication -- this shard does not merge or delete rows itself.

Recommend Owner1 = 'Sabine Crossing Pipeline, LLC', 100%.
